title: Non cook surface chipping off after about 20 uses
text: Non cook surface chipping off after about 20 uses. We loved this pan initially.  Nothing sticks to it and it's really easy to clean.  But after about 20 uses, we've discovered the non-stick surface is chipping away.  We've used the pan exclusively for frying eggs and breakfast fry-ups.  We've used nothing but flexible plastic utensils.  I'd give a one star review except that for the 1st 20 uses, this was like, my favorite frying pan ever.
